families.name: Power / Quaternion
families.summary: Escape-time power maps and higher-dimensional analogs.
families.historicalInfo: Power-based 3D fractals evolved from attempts to generalize Mandelbrot dynamics to spherical and quaternion spaces.

types.title: Mandelbulb
types.subtitle: 3D Mandelbrot-style power fractal
types.historicalInfo: The Mandelbulb (c. 2009) became the de facto 3D analog to the Mandelbrot set in digital art communities.

variants.name: Julia Bulb
variants.summary: Julia-mode Mandelbulb using constant C offset.

families.name: Flame (Draves)
families.summary: 2D/2.5D iterated function systems using weighted non-linear variations.
families.historicalInfo: Fractal Flames were introduced by Scott Draves and Erik Reckase (early 2000s) and popularized via flam3 and Electric Sheep.

types.title: Fractal Flame (flam3)
types.subtitle: Reference implementation and XML ecosystem
types.historicalInfo: flam3 defines transform sets, variation weights, affine coefficients, and rendering metadata in XML.

variants.name: flam3 Project
variants.summary: Open the canonical flam3 repository and docs.
